# Copilot Instructions for CHURCH-PORTAL

This file tracks the setup and development progress for the church portal application.

## Checklist
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
- [x] Scaffold the Project
- [x] Customize the Project
- [x] Install Required Extensions
- [x] Compile the Project
- [x] Create and Run Task
- [x] Launch the Project
- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete

## Notes
- Project will use Node.js/Express backend, React frontend, Azure SQL, Azure Blob Storage, Google OAuth, and Nodemailer.
- Features: expense submission, offering entry, file upload, email notifications, reporting, admin/treasurer dashboard.
- Deployment and testing instructions will be provided for Azure.
